We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we don't have the compound given. Possibly we need to infer from NMR? No input data. Maybe the sample is the one at hand, we can get NMR spectra to deduce? But we don't know structure. Could be that the system expects us to query carbon_nmr_spectra or proton_nmr_spectra to get data, then count methyl signals. Use proton NMR: CH3 groups give singlet (or multiplet) around 0.9-1.2 ppm, integration 3H each. But we need integration data. The tool returns spectra as string, maybe includes integration.

We should call proton_nmr_spectra to get data.
